title: Calcutta High Court Declines TMC's Plea To Operate Bank Accounts Frozen By ED
description: The Calcutta High Court on Monday refused to grant interim relief to the All India Trinamool Congress (TMC) by permitting it to operate three bank accounts frozen by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) in a money laundering case involving alleged transfers of party funds for the purchase of an aircraft and a helicopter. Justice Krishna Rao declined to stay the ED's debit freeze while hearing the political party's writ petition challenging the agency's action under the Prevention of Money Laundering
